preferences.voice: active 'we' in Introduction and Discussion; passive in Methods when apparatus or procedure is the topic
preferences.transitions: avoid sentence-initial 'Moreover' and 'Furthermore'; rely on given-to-new lexical links
preferences.abbreviations: define in Abstract and again at first occurrence in the main text

conventions.citation_style: parenthetical (Author, Year) unless the author is the grammatical subject
conventions.unit_spacing: space between value and unit except % (e.g., 25 °C, 95%)
conventions.bilingual_first_mention: Chinese term (English Term, ABBR) on first occurrence only in Chinese technical notes

preferences.opening: lead each major section with verification status and boundary conditions before design details
preferences.rules: state completion criteria using observable signals (e.g., register flag cleared) rather than indirect negations

preferences.tense: simple past for performed procedures; present tense for enduring equations and apparatus specs

exceptions: Retain 'significant' when reporting a statistical test and 'robust' when naming the specific disturbance resisted.
Retain domain terms such as '闭环控制' or '门控' when they name the actual engineering or model mechanism.
Retain explicit negations that define a safety, diagnostic, or operational boundary.

evidence.note: Prefer passive in Methods, active 'we' in Discussion; remove sentence-initial 'Moreover'.
